name: Cinder
description: a living spark from a burning village: a small teardrop-shaped flame with a hot white-yellow core and orange-red edges, two bright black beady eyes and a mischievous grin, a thin trail of smoke and sparks behind it

poses.stand: floating in the air, its flame tip flickering upward
poses.popped: bursting apart into a scatter of tiny sparks and a puff of smoke

idle.action: floats in place, its flame flickering and wobbling, blinking its eyes

move.action: leans forward and drifts toward the right, its flame streaming backward, staying in the same spot in the frame

die.action: puffs up and pops into a burst of sparks and smoke
